title: Define hosted verification records
responsibility: Defines the accepted structure of a hosted verification record and its recorded results.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceRecord
outputs.description: A Zod strict-object schema that defines the accepted shape for validating hosted verification records, but does not attest that recorded evidence is truthful. It uses declared status enums, lowercase 40-character hexadecimal commit hashes and finite numbers, rejects unknown keys on strict objects, and applies 1,000,000-character string, 1–300-character name and 5,000-item array limits where the shared helpers are used; optional browser diagnostics use the imported diagnostic schema.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Calling parse() on this schema throws a ZodError when a value violates the declared record shape or field constraints.
